target: Confirming identity, code name: Rover. Top-level access to the Woodveil Hall laboratory granted. May this item guide you to the answers and enlightenment we seek.

source: Identitätsmarke, die von Mitgliedern der Schwarzen Küsten verwendet wird. Du kannst die Welle der Relikt-Energie spüren, wenn du sie in den Händen hältst.
target: Identity mark used by members of the Black Shores. You can feel the surge of Remnant Energy when carrying it with your hands.

source: Idyllic Dwelling
target: The Idyllic Refuge

source: Igual que las plantas, el Essehalo que flota sobre los Solistirpes crece y da frutos, que se conservan con sumo cuidado y se ofrecen a quienes se ganan la confianza de los Solistirpe.
target: Like plants, the Essehalo floating above the Soliskin grows and bears fruits, which are carefully preserved and later given to those who earn the Soliskin's trust.

source: Ihr Armband
target: Her Bracelet

source: Ihr Schwur
target: Her Oath

source: Ihre Gestalt bleibt wie ein Traum – verschwommen und außer Reichweite. Doch eines Tages werden sich eure Wege kreuzen …
target: She lingers like a dream, just out of reach. But one day, your paths will cross...

source: Ihre Wünsche
target: Her Wishes

source: Il contient un compte rendu des événements survenus à Kahei pendant son séjour au camp d'exil, ainsi que des sentiments et des attentes aléatoires.
target: It contains a record of what happened during Jiaping's stay in the Exile camp, as well as some nonsensical feelings and expectations.

source: Il continuait à lancer les dés, priant silencieusement pour ne pas avoir à affronter son destin de plein fouet. Pourtant, au fond de lui, il savait qu'en persistant à jouer, son choix était déjà fait. Il était prêt à mettre un terme à tout cela.
target: He continued to roll the dice, silently praying that he wouldn't be forced to face the fate head-on. Yet, deep down, he understood that by continuing to roll, he had already made his choice. He was prepared to bring it all to an end.

source:
Il est dit que les Tours de la Couronne d'Épines cachent le début honorable de la famille Fisalia.
On ressent l'inquiétude et la confusion à travers les touches délicates de l'artiste.
target:
According to legend, the Thorncrown Rises, located in Thessaleo Fells, holds the lost glory of the Fisalia family.
Through the painter's delicate brushstrokes, one can sense her upset and confusion.

source: Il est dit que quand cette espèce de Gulboules explose, elle apporte un air sucré, c'est pourquoi on l'utilise comme le Feu d'artifice dans les cérémonies de mariage.
target: It is said that this particular type of Gulpuff releases a sweet fragrance when it explodes, making it a sought-after material for crafting wedding fireworks.

source: Il paraît qu'une grande star de cinéma adore des bonbons pattes de chat, ce qui les rend très prisés.
target: A famous movie star is said to love Stuffed Cat Paw Gummy Candy, which makes these very much in demand.

source: Il paraît que le porte-clés Namipon en édition limitée peut se revendre très cher.
target: They say the Limited-Run Namipon Keychain has high resale value.

source: Il s'agit apparemment d'une lettre de la famille d'une personne. Le conteur de théâtre de Jinzhou s'intéresse à celui-ci.
target: These letters home are someone's messenger. The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these fragments.

source: Il s'agit apparemment d'une note manuscrite d'un logisticien. Le conteur de théâtre de Jinzhou s'intéresse à celui-ci.
target: They seem to come from a diary of a courier. The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these fragments.

source: Il s'agit d'un matériau rare qui ne produit la tortue de l'Autoharp que sous l'influence d'une fréquence spécifique. On dit qu'entre les mains d'un apothicaire compétent, il peut être transformé en un remède curatif miraculeux.
target: A rare material from the Bell-Borne Geochelone, which only appears at a specific frequency. It's said that in the hands of a skilled apothecary, it can be refined into a miraculous medicine.

source: Il s'agit d'un matériau rare qui ne produit la tortue de l'Autoharp que sous l'influence d'une fréquence spécifique. On dit qu'entre les mains d'un apothicaire compétent, il peut être transformé en un remède curatif miraculeux.
target: A rare material that only resonates under specific frequencies from the Bell-Borne Geochelone. It's said that in the hands of a skilled apothecary, it can be refined into a miraculous medicine.

source: Il s'agit d'une puce de données ramassée au Port de Guixu, qui semble être le journal de guerre d'un guerrier.
target: A data chip picked up in the Port City of Guixu. Seems to be a battlefield record of a warrior.

source: Il s'agit en quelque sorte de verser de l'argent.
target: "The Precious" given by Qingru.

source: Il s'agit en quelque sorte de verser de l'argent.
target: Qingru's "heavy gold".

source: Il semble qu'il s'agisse d'un enregistrement occasionnel du personnel du mineur. Le conteur de théâtre de Jinzhou s'intéresse à celui-ci.
target: They are casual daily records by the staff at the Mine. The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these.

source: Il semble que ce soit une carte de prière pour un rituel ancien.
target: A Wooden Plaque for some kind of ancient rituals.

source: Il semble que ce soit une carte de prière pour un rituel ancien.
target: It seems to be a prayer plaque for some ancient ceremony

source: Il semble y avoir une lune brillante dans la brèche ......
target: A bright moon seems to hide in the crevice...

source: Il semble y avoir une rouille inhabituelle sur la base de la bouteille.
target: There appears to be unusual rust on the base of the bottle.

source: Il semble être une invitation.
target:
With a subtle delightful scent, it reads: "Behold Hongzhen in its entirety, next to a ring and hanging eaves. When eternal snow thaws into flowing streams, let us reconvene."
It appears to be an invitation.

source: Il semblerait que ce soit votre propre carte d'étudiant de l'Académie Brandétoile.
target: An old student ID from Startorch Academy, said to have been yours once.

source: Il sert de pion sombre à des adversaires invisibles et annonce l'arrivée incessante des malheurs de la guerre.
target: It serves as the shadowy pawn of unseen adversaries and heralds the onset of ceaseless woes of war.

source: Il y a des moments où l'on peut se libérer de tout masque. Après tout, nous sommes ici pour nous amuser.
target: There are moments when you can cast aside every disguise. After all, we're here for a great time.

source: Il y a toujours quelqu'un qui veut l'avoir, pour l'argent, pour les amis.
target: There is always someone who wants to own it, for money, for friends.

source: Il émet un cliquetis métallique sourd quand on le secoue. On dirait qu'il est rempli de pièces... et de quelques rêves oubliés depuis longtemps.
target: It gives off a dull metallic clatter when shaken. It seems like it's packed with coins... and some dreams long since forgotten.

source: Illuminez le ciel avec un feu d'artifice ! Lancez-le dans le jardin une fois la nuit tombée... une surprise magique vous attend. (Terminez la quête « La réponse est l'embouchure d'une rivière d'étoiles » pour débloquer)
target: A firework launcher has been set up in the Garden. Give it a try and paint the night sky with brilliant colors (Complete Quest "The Answer Is Where a River of Stars Falls" to unlock).

source: Ils proviennent des journaux des chercheurs, avec des annotations de certaines connaissances. Le conteur du théâtre de Jinzhou collecte ces fragments.
target: They come from Researchers' journals, with annotations from some acquaintance. The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these fragments.

source: Im Feuer geschmiedet, zum Siegen ausgebildet.
target: Forged in fire, honed to prevail.

source: Im Inneren befinden sich ein abgenutzter Satz Neun Verbundene Ringe und ein halb geöffnetes Schreiben. Von einer Tochter für ihren Vater zurückgelassen, sind diese Token so still wie sie selbst – ein lautloser Beweis ihrer unausgesprochenen Fürsorge.
target: Inside is a well-worn Nine Linked Rings puzzle, and a half-opened letter. Left behind by a daughter for her father, these tokens are as quiet as she was—a silent proof of her unspoken care.

source: Im Institut reißen die Diskussionen über die Kampfmechas der Zwillingsnova-Serie nie ab. Ihre Entwicklung und ihre eleganten Kampfmanöver bleiben ein beliebtes Thema unter den Forschern.
target: At the Institute, discussions about the Twin Nova series combat mechs never seem to die down. Their development and their elegant combat maneuvers remain a favorite topic among researchers.

target: When in combat, Resonators gain higher DMG Reduction over time. This effect is removed when Resonators take damage or leave combat.

source: Im ersten Akt betrat ein unbekannter junger Mann das Schiff mit nichts als einem Dolch. Im letzten Akt traf ein berüchtigter Piratenkapitän sein Ende, von seinem eigenen Vertrauten verraten, versank er mit einem Dolch in die Tiefe.
target: In the opening act, an obscure youth boarded the ship with nothing but a dagger. In the final act, a notorious pirate captain met his end, betrayed by his own confidant, sinking with a dagger into the deep.

target: Flames ignite the cheers of the arena, as the wolf tears out the throats of every shadow. She is the brightest star on the field.

source: Im warmen Dunst der Indoor-Therme, verborgen hinter wehenden Chiffonvorhängen, ruht der Blick der lorbeergekrönten Nymphe – sanft, einladend, wie ein stilles Versprechen auf einen lang ersehnten, unbeschwerten Urlaub.
target: In the warm mist of the indoor hot spring, behind the fluttering chiffon veils, the laurel-crowned nymph casts her gentle gaze—a signal of invitation to a long-awaited, carefree holiday.

target: A wide array of weapons is showcased in the Collection Gallery. But remember, in a land of peace, they are for display only.

target: In the fissure, a Tacet Mark is expanding, pulsing with a thudding rhythm like a heartbeat...

source: In den Tiefen des Auges steht ein umgedrehter Leuchtturm. Erwidert diese schwarze Flut deine Blicke, wenn du sie anschaust?
target: Deep within the pupil stands an inverted lighthouse. When you gaze into it, does that black tide gaze into you as well?

source: In den Tiefen des Meeres, wo wandernde Seelen endlos umherirren, hast du immer wieder Krisen verhindert. Unter dem Licht, das du entzündet hast, haben sie endlich ihren Weg nach Hause gefunden.
target: In the abyssal dark, you stilled numerous tempests unnamed. Under the beacon you ignited, wandering souls have finally found their way home.

source: In den Träumen der Seele tanzt du mit allen in den Tiefen.
target: You plummeted to the ocean's abyss, where numerous valiant souls lie silently in their eternal vigil.

source: In einem silbernem Shuttle treibt ein Reisender über den See des Herzens. Der Traum scheint sich endlos zu erstrecken.
target: A traveler rides upon the silver shuttle as it drifts across the lake of the heart. The dream stretches on and on, with no end to it.

target: In one, Camellya sits on a chair, seemingly talking to someone nearby.

In einer Welt, die aus Energie und Harmonie geschaffen ist, können alle Wörter und Geschichten in Musik gesungen werden.
"Ich kam in diese Welt, brachte nichts als Papier, Seil und einen Schatten mit."
target:
In a world constructed out of energy and syntony, all words and stories can be sung in music.

Je suis cendre, je suis flamme ; je suis obscurité, pourtant je suis « salut ».

target:
I am ash, I am flame; I am darkness, yet I am salvation.
Though light falters and torments sear my flesh, still I remain true to my oath. My undying flame shall scour all evil.

I am thou and thou art I.

Je suis toi, tu es moi.
Plutôt que de rester cachée derrière les braises...tu veux connaître le triomphe.

I am thou and thou art I.

source:
L'Épée de Discorde - « Hognis ».
Une épée d'origine inconnue. Selon Cartethyia, elle pourrait bien être la clé pour percer le sceau de la Tour renversée.
Elle dégage une aura qui est aussi profonde et mystérieuse que les abysses.
target:
The Sword of Discord—Hognis.

A blade of unknown origin. According to Cartethyia, it seems to be the key to unraveling the seal in the Inverted Tower.

It exudes an aura as deep and mysterious as the abyss of the sea.

source:
L'Épée de Divinité - « Tyrvine ».

Une épée qui a scellé une partie de puissance de la Sentinelle Imperator, est l'artefact utilisé pour choisir Leur Résonatrice.

En vous en approchant, vous pourriez entendre le faible hurlement du vent.
target:
The Sword of Divinity—"Tyrvine."

A blade sealed with the very powers of Sentinel Imperator, and the artifact used to select Their Resonator.

Approach it, and you might hear the faint howling of the wind.

source:
L'Épée de Vertu - « Haultir »
Autrefois entre les mains de Carthethyia, cette épée est l'une des clés pour briser le sceau.

The Sword of Virtue—Haultir.

This sword once belonging to Cartethyia has now become one of the keys to unraveling the seal.

La Coquille radieuse est une sorte de coquillage perlé. Lorsqu'elle est exposée à la lumière, sa couche perlière émet un étrange éclat.
Lorsque la marée est basse, on trouve beaucoup de coquilles sur la plage.

Chromeshell is a pearl shell. Under illumination, its nacre will glow with a strange polychrome gloss.
When it ebbs, many Chromeshells will be left on beaches.

source:
La Divinidad susurró en su oído, y ella le respondió con la espada. El destino le había escrito un guion, pero ella lo hizo trizas.
Eligió su propio camino: adentrarse en la tormenta.

The Divinity spoke whispers in her ears, she swung her sword in reply. Fate has written her a script, she tore the pages to shreds.
She has chosen her own path through gale and tide.

source:
La Divinité lui a murmuré à l'oreille, mais son épée s'est abattue sur Elle. Le Destin avait écrit son scénario, mais elle en réduisit les pages en lambeaux.

target: The rock shell covering the arm of Feilian Beringal, named for the thunderous roar of Feilian's heavy punch.

source: La carne obtenida de los peces, con una textura tierna y un sabor fresco, puede convertirse en un plato perfecto en las manos de un buen cocinero.
target: Meat obtained from fish, featuring a tender cut with a refreshing taste. With skilled hands, it can be transformed into exquisite dishes.

source: La carta en la mano de Scar con la marca de una oveja negra, la llama adherida a ella parece nunca extinguirse. Y esa llama arderá para siempre con el deseo de destrucción interminable de Scar.
target: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.

source: La carte au trésor enfin complète révèle l'emplacement d'un fabuleux butin.
target: A fully pieced-together treasure map marking hidden treasure.

source:
La carte d'étudiant que Chisa a emportée par accident lors de la Tempête de néant. Le plastique est usé, mais votre visage reste reconnaissable.
Il y a plus de vingt ans, vous arpentiez les couloirs de l'Académie Brandétoile.
target:
The student ID Chisa unintentionally took amid the Void Storm.
The ID is eroded, but you can still make out your face in the picture.
Twenty-odd years ago, you once roamed the halls of Startorch Academy.

source: La carte portant la marque du mouton noir dans la main de Scar avait une flamme ardente attachée à elle, comme si elle ne devait jamais s'éteindre. Et cette flamme brûlera à jamais, tout comme le désir de destruction de Scar.
target: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.

source: La cassette qu'Aemeath utilisait autrefois. Elle est encore décorée d'un autocollant qui lui donne une touche personnelle.
target: The cassette Aemeath once used, still bearing a sticker that was unmistakably hers.

source: La celebración llega a su cénit. Presencia un espectáculo de fuegos artificiales único, concebido para este momento tan especial (Completa la misión «Respuesta bajo el río estrellado» para desbloquear).
target:
Bring the party to its climax and witness the most breathtaking fireworks that exist only for this very moment.
(Unlocks after completing the Quest "The Answer Is Where a River of Stars Falls")

source: La chance est aussi un pouvoir
target: Luck is also power.

source: La chanson d'anniversaire 2025, magnifiquement interprétée par l'Équipe de peluches.
target: The 2025 birthday song, magnificently performed by the Plushie Squad.

source: La chanson d'anniversaire 2026, spécialement réadaptée par vos chers amis.
target: The 2026 birthday song, specially readapted by your dear friends.

source: La chanson interprétée lors de la cérémonie d'anniversaire.
target: The song performed during the anniversary ceremony.

source: La chispa entre las grietas acabará por incendiarlo todo
target: The spark in the rift will eventually ignite a blaze...

source: La clé de la meute des singes magiciens.
target: Key obtained from the Hoochief group.

source: La clé du phare d'Hameau des Timoniers, qui permet d'activer le phare.

source: La clé du phare, qui permet d'activer le phare d'Hameau des Timoniers.
target: Use this key to activate the lighthouse in Helm Village.

source: La clé du phare, qui permet d'activer le phare de la Baie de sérénité.
target: Use this key to activate the lighthouse in Serene Bay.

source: La clé obtenue des Houlices.
target: Key obtained from the Hoochief group.

source: La clé pour ouvrir la porte de laboratoire à l'Arc de bois.
target: A key used to open the Woodveil Hall laboratory.

source: La clé qui permet de déverrouiller les passages cachés de la Forêt
target: A key that can open the hidden passage of the Dim Forest.

source: La clé qui permet de déverrouiller les passages cachés de la Forêt de l'Eclaircie.
target: A key that can open the hidden passage in the Dim Forest.

source: La collaboration entre Jewel Boba et l'Association Pionnière pour Le Sol-2 a commencé, apportant des « joyaux » exclusifs à Le Sol-2!
target: An in-game item redemption code that can be used to redeem Second Coming of Solaris x Jewel Boba Collaboration Pack.

source: La concha de roca que cubre el brazo de Beringal del Bosque, nombrada por su rugido atronador del golpe pesado.
target: The rock shell covering the arm of Feilian Beringal, named for the thunderous roar of Feilian's heavy punch.

source: La contraseña es «familia»
target: The Password Is Family

source: La crise virtuelle créée par le système Tethys défie la raison, mais vous y avez répondu en dépassant vos propres limites, debout tel un symbole vivant luttant contre la calamité et éclairant la voie pour tous.
target: The Tethys System's Virtual Crises defy all reason, but you vanquished your limits in response. Now, you stand as a living beacon against the possible calamities, lighting the way forward.

source: La cuna que contiene el vacío
target: Cradle That Holds the Void

source: La determinación que arde por todo o nada
target: The Resolve that Burns for All or Nothing

source: La divination... Hé, laisse-moi d'abord consulter les notes de mon maître.
target: Reading fortunes... Heh, let me check my master's notes first.

source: La durabilité du bouclier est augmentée de {0}.
target: Shields gained are increased by {0}.

source: La durabilité du bouclier est augmentée.
target: Shields gained are increased.

La duración de [Lluvia de espadas] aumenta {0} s.

Dato curioso
Cartethyia ideó algunas de sus técnicas de espada mientras jugaba con marionetas de mano en Avinoleum.
target:
The duration of Sword Barrage is increased by {0}s.

Fun Fact
Cartethyia came up with some of her sword techniques while playing with her hand puppets at Avinoleum.

source:
La durée de « Pluie de lame » est augmentée de {0} s.

Anecdote
Cartethyia doit certaines de ses techniques d'épée actuelles à un éclair d'inspiration survenu alors qu'elle jouait avec des marionnettes à doigts dans la Tour inversée.
target:
The duration of Sword Barrage is increased by {0}s.

Fun Fact
Cartethyia came up with some of her sword techniques while playing with her hand puppets at Avinoleum.

source: La edición de coleccionista del décimo aniversario de "Lágrimas de Hoja de Piedra".
target: The tenth anniversary collector's edition of "Stone Leaf Tears".

source: La edición de coleccionista del décimo aniversario del libro de cuentos "Lágrima de Hoja de Piedra".
target: The tenth anniversary collector's edition of the storybook "Stone Leaf Tear".

source: La espada desprende un aura tan profunda y misteriosa como el abismo del mar.
target: The blade exudes an aura as deep and mysterious as the abyss of the sea.

source: La experiencia obtenida al completar las tareas del Podcast Pionero se puede usar para mejorar el nivel del Podcast Pionero.
target: Experience obtained from completing Podcast Tasks can be used to upgrade the Podcast level.

source: La experiencia utilizada para mejorar el nivel del Módulo de Datos se puede obtener al desbloquear un nuevo Eco.
target: The experience used to upgrade the Data Bank level can be obtained by unlocking new Echo.

source: La extraña música en la grieta es interminable...
target: Mysterious melodies echo endless from the crevice...

source: La falaise tombe du haut, le dragon nage entre les nuages.
target: Above towering cliffs that reach for the sky, a true dragon emerges from the clouds.

source: La farine offerte par Margherita
target: Margherita's Gift of Flour

source: La fiesta que desvela misterios
target: The Revelry that Unveils Mysteries

source: La finale qui n'atteint jamais son but
target: The Finale that Fails to Reach

source: La fleur jumelle
target: Honeysuckle

source: La flor en la nieve
target: Bloom in Snow

source: La fortuna también constituye un tipo de poder.
target: Luck is also power.

source: La foto grupal con tus compañeros después de ver «La historia del asura que despeja demonios».
target: The group photo with your Companions after watching "The Tale of Demon-Banishing Asura" together.

source: La foto panorámica cerca del campamento del Noveno Cuerpo de Investigación de las Llanuras Centrales.
target: The scenic photo near the camp of the Ninth Investigation Corps of the Central Plains.

source: La foto panorámica tomada por Athos, él perdió accidentalmente la cámara, esperando que Errante pueda encontrar la cámara a través de la foto panorámica.
target: Scenery photos taken by Athos. He accidentally left behind his camera, hoping that Rover would find the camera through these landscape photos.

source: La foto que Duzhou siempre lleva consigo. En ella hay tres personas vestidas de Custodios de Xuanfang, riendo y abrazándose. Al pie están escritos sus nombres: Duzhou, Yanlang y Mingyu.
target: The photo that Duzhou always carries. In it are three people in Xuanfang Warden garb, laughing and embracing each other. At the bottom are written their names: Duzhou, Yanlang, and Mingyu.

source: La frecuencia de las monedas que encuentras en el Festival Eterno. Se puede intercambiar por adornos de Cobb Copo.
target: A coin frequency found at Forever Fest. Can be exchanged for decorations from Cobb Copo.

source: La frecuencia que perdura en la tela aún recuerda a las batallas de antaño.
target: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old.

source: La frecuencia que perdura en la tela aún recuerda a las batallas de antaño. Si se presenta ante una Piedra Guía destrozada, el espíritu del Implacable responderá a la llamada, guiando al viajero perdido hacia delante.
target: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old. Present it at a shattered Waystone, and the unyielding spirit shall answer the call, guiding the lost traveler forward.

source: La fréquence qui persiste sur le tissu fait encore écho aux batailles d'autrefois.
target: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old.

source: La fréquence qui persiste sur le tissu fait encore écho aux batailles d'autrefois. Présentez-le devant une balise brisée, et l'esprit inébranlable répondra à l'appel, guidant le voyageur égaré.
target: The frequency lingering on the cloth still echoes the battles of old. Present it at a shattered Waystone, and the unyielding spirit shall answer the call, guiding the lost traveler forward.

source: La fête est là, en espérant que tout le monde appréciera les friandises de cette année.
target: Festival's here, hoping everyone enjoys this year's treats.

source: La gastronomie et les voyages vont toujours de pair. Qu'elle entreprenne un périple empli de joie.
target: Good food and travel always go hand in hand. May she set off on a journey filled with joy.

source: La gema en el colgante del collar, que parece estar incrustada en algún lugar.
target: The gem on the necklace pendant, which seems to be inlaid somewhere.

source: La gema en el collar.
target: The gem on the necklace.

source: La gema obtenida después de que el collar fue destruido.
target: The gem obtained after the necklace was destroyed.

source: La gloire brûle sans fin sur le domaine de la chasse.
target: Glory blazes eternal on the hunting grounds.

source: La gloria resplandece eterna en los terrenos de caza.
target: Glory blazes eternal on the hunting grounds.

source: La graine de l'arbre perchoir céleste. Ses bractées opposées se déploient largement, évoquant une paire d'ailes reposant sur une branche.
target: The seed of the Cloudperch Tree. Its opposing bracts spread open widely, resembling a pair of wings resting upon a branch.

source: La hoja con una superficie completamente cristalizada.
target: The leaf with a completely crystallized surface.

source: La hora del té
target: Afternoon Tea Time

source: La insignia obtenida al completar el desafío de Cumbre Gloriosa puede canjearse por recompensas en la «Selección radiante».
target: A badge earned by completing the challenges of Peaks of Prestige. Can be used to redeem rewards in Radiant Selection.

source: La lanterne était ensevelie dans le givre, comme si un morceau d'histoire avait été enterré à l'intérieur. Une personne est venue pour la garder, sombrant dans un profond sommeil jusqu'au premier souffle du printemps.
target: The lantern is entombed in frost, as if a piece of history had been buried within. Someone cradled it, sinking into a deep slumber until the first breath of spring.

source: La legendaria consola de juegos que marcó el comienzo de una nueva era en los videojuegos. Los fanáticos la consideran una reliquia sagrada.
target: The legendary game console that ushered in the dawn of a new era in video gaming. Revered by enthusiasts as a sacred relic.

source: La leyenda cuenta que se trata de una artista de la tijera especialista en dar caza a Disonancias Tácitas por todo Honami. ¡Qué presencia! ¡Quién pudiera sostenerle la mirada!
target: Legend has it that she is the Mysterious Scissorswoman hunting down Tacet Discords in Honami. How long can you meet her gaze?

source: La leyenda dice que esta burbuja se forma con el aliento de Cetus el Rompemareas, y sirve como refugio natural para los peces... hasta que los pescadores revientan su burbuja santuario.
target: Legend has it that this bubble forms from the breath of the Cetus the Tidebreaker, serving as a natural shelter for fish... until fishermen burst their bubble of sanctuary.

source: La limite de l'Effet Fléau des Vagues est augmentée.
target: Stack cap of Status - Waveworn Bane is increased.

source: La llamada de la tierra perdida
target: The Call that Comes from a Lost Land

source: La llave del faro de la Bahía Serena, que sirve para activarlo.
target: Use this key to activate the lighthouse in Serene Bay.

source: La llave del faro de la Punta Timón, que sirve para activarlo.
target: Use this key to activate the lighthouse in Helm Village.

source: La llave que soltó el Volador que sobrevuela el antiguo sitio. Independientemente del estilo o la apariencia, parece bastante antiguo.
target: A key dropped by Blobfly in Kaimi Remnant Site. It got quite the ancient looks and style.

source: La llave que soltó el Volador.
target: The key dropped by Blobfly.

source: La lumière de la brèche éblouit ......
target: Dazzling rays of light are emanating from the crevice...

source: La lumière des étoiles tombe dans les profondeurs de la mer, comblant toute sa nostalgie et son vide. Dans l'immensité et la solitude, elle veille sur ce littoral qui n'existe que grâce à lui... C'est son devoir inné, tant passé que futur.
target: Starlight falls into the deep sea, filling all of her longing and emptiness. In vastness and loneliness, she stood watch over the shores that exist only because of him... This is her innate duty, both past and future.

source: La luz de las estrellas en los ojos es una improvisación que jamás llega a su fin.
target: Starlight in the eyes is an impromptu that never ends.

source: La luz estelar cae en las profundidades del mar, llenando todo su vacío y añoranza. En la inmensidad y la soledad, vigilaba una costa que solo existe gracias a él... Este es su deber innato, tanto su pasado como su futuro.
target: Starlight falls into the deep sea, filling all of her longing and emptiness. In vastness and loneliness, she stood watch over the shores that exist only because of him... This is her innate duty, both past and future.

source: La légendaire console qui a marqué le début d'une nouvelle ère pour le jeu vidéo. Une véritable relique sacrée pour les fans.
target: The legendary game console that ushered in the dawn of a new era in video gaming. Revered by enthusiasts as a sacred relic.

source: La légende raconte qu'il s'agit de la femme aux ciseaux, une silhouette énigmatique qui traque les Tacets Discords à Honami. Combien de temps oserez-vous soutenir son regard ?
target: Legend has it that she is the Mysterious Scissorswoman hunting down Tacet Discords in Honami. How long can you meet her gaze?

source: La légende raconte que cette bulle se forme à partir du souffle du Cetus le Brise-marée, servant de refuge naturel pour les poissons... jusqu'à ce que les pêcheurs éclatent leur bulle de confort.
target: Legend has it that this bubble forms from the breath of the Cetus the Tidebreaker, serving as a natural shelter for fish... until fishermen burst their bubble of sanctuary.

source: La marea murmura, la luz estival permanece. Disfruta este momento de ocio.
target: The tides murmur, summer lingers. Stay with this easy, quiet moment.

source: La mayoría de los desarrolladores de juegos de Solaris no tienen ni idea de por qué los corazones rojos representan los PS. Pero bueno, si todos lo hacen, mejor seguir la corriente.
target: Most game developers in Solaris have no clue why a red heart represents HP. But hey, if everyone's doing it, going with the flow should be fine.

source: La medalla que perdió Zhizhi.
target: The medal lost by Zhi Zhi.

source: La memoria puede desvanecerse, pero esta amistad entre mundos conservará sus colores.
target: Memory may fade, but this cross-realm friendship will keep its colors.

source: La mirada que perfora el tiempo
target: The Gaze that Pierces Through Time

source: La moitié d'un pendentif en jade détenu par la sœur de Dewvetch, il semble que ce soit une autre partie du pentatif de Dewvetch.
target: A half of a jade pendant held by Dewvetch's sister, it seems to match the jade pendant held by Dewvetch.

source: La moneda pesquera que circula en las islas Riccioli. Se puede usar para comprar equipo de pesca y cubrir gastos diarios.
target: The fishery coin circulated within the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to purchase fishing gear and cover daily expenses.

target: The fishery coin circulated within the Riccioli Islands. Used to purchase fishing gear and cover daily expenses.

source: La moneda universal de Solaris-3 que se puede usar para comprar suministros y recompensas en el Mercado Estelar.
target: The universal currency of the Sonoro Cosmos. Can be exchanged for supplies and rewards at the Stardock Market.

source: La moneda universal de Solaris-3.
target: The universal currency of Solaris-3.

source: La moneda universal emitida por Huanglong, reconocida oficialmente en muchas regiones.
target: The universal currency issued by Huanglong, officially recognized across many regions.

source: La monnaie du Cosmos Sonora qui peut être échangée contre des matériaux et des récompenses au Marché du port.
target: The universal currency of the Sonoro Cosmos. Can be exchanged for supplies and rewards at the Stardock Market.

target: The universal currency of the Sonoro Cosmos. Can be exchanged for supplies and rewards at the Stardock Market.

source: La monnaie numérique de Night City. Collectez-les et échangez-les contre des récompenses avec les Edgerunners.
target: The digital currency of Night City brought by the Edgerunners. Collect and exchange them for rewards with the Edgerunners.

source: La monnaie universelle de Solaris-3.
target: The universal currency of Solaris-3.

source: La monnaie à utiliser pour acheter des objets dans la boutique.
target: The currency used to exchange for items in Store.

source: La monnaie émise par Huanglong. Reconnue par les autorités des régions différentes.
target: The universal currency issued by Huanglong, officially recognized across many regions.

source: La mouche d'or est un prédateur des zones humides et des eaux, dont la recette englobe les insectes volants, les petits poissons et les crevettes. Elle est connue pour la rapidité de son vol et de sa chasse.
target: Golden-ringed Dragonfly is a wetland and water predator. Its diet includes flying insects and small fish and shrimp. It is known for rapid flying and predating speed.

source: La musique de fond de l'avion en papier s'envole vers le ciel.
target: Background music played when the paper plane soars into the sky

source: La musique de fond s'entend à l'intérieur de la station Arche spatiale
target: Background music played while inside the SkyArk Space Station.

source: La musique de thème de la quête « Quand le ciel assiste à notre rencontre », obtenue des Lucioles de notes à la Plaine d'Os du Titan - Voie du héros.
target: Background music of Exploration Quest "When the Sky Watches Us Meet." Obtain the Melody Box for this song from the Musicfly at the Hero's Way of Titanbone Expanse.

source: La musique de thème du Nexus entre les pierres, obtenue des Lucioles de notes à la Plaine d'Os du Titan.
target: Background music of Central Hub. Obtain the Melody Box for this track from the Musicfly in the Titanbone Expanse.

source: La musique de thème du combat contre la Dame de la Mer, obtenue en complétant la quête principale « Les Flammes du cœur ».
target: Background music played when fighting the Lady of the Sea. Unlocked after completing Main Quest "Flames of Heart."

source: La musique de thème quand vous affrontez Augusta, obtenue en complétant la quête principale « Par la main brûlante du soleil ».
target: Background music played when crossing blades with Augusta. Unlocked after completing Main Quest "By Sun's Burning Hand."

source: La musique de thème à l'arrivée au Septimont, obtenue des Lucioles de notes à la Plaine d'Os du Titan.
target: Background music played when first arriving in Septimont. Obtained the Melody Box of this track from the Musicfly in the port of Titanbone Expanse.

source: La música recolectada en el Abismo de ensueño, que registra las melodías únicas del Somnolencia.
target: Music found within Dreaming Deep, bearing unique tunes of the Somnoire.

source: La neige fond en un instant. La brise printanière efface tout.
target: Snow yields in an instant. Spring breeze leaves no trace.

source: La nieve se desvanece en un instante; la brisa primaveral lo disipa todo.
target: Snow yields in an instant. Spring breeze leaves no trace.

source: La noche parecía interminable y la oscuridad campaba a sus anchas. Aferrándose al último vestigio de luz entre sus brazos, en su estado de aturdimiento lo confundió con la primera luz del amanecer.
target: The night was far too long, so long that even the end of the endless dark was nowhere to be found. Holding tight to the final spark of light in her arms, in her haze, she mistook it for the breaking dawn.

source: La note de défi de Peso que vous avez obtenue.
target: Peso's Challenge Note you obtained.

source: La nuit était bien trop longue, si longue que même la fin des ténèbres infinies était introuvable. Serrant fort la dernière étincelle de lumière dans ses bras, dans sa confusion, elle la prit pour l'aube qui se lève.
target: The night was far too long, so long that even the end of the endless dark was nowhere to be found. Holding tight to the final spark of light in her arms, in her haze, she mistook it for the breaking dawn.

source: La ola que purifica el mundo
target: The Wave that Cleanses the World

source: La pajarita del conejo
target: The Rabbit's Bow Tie

source: La peinture capture la Sainte Demoiselle en pleine contemplation au Séminaire. Bien qu'elle ait subi l'épreuve du temps, son aura sacrée demeure intacte.
target: The painting captures the Blessed Maiden's contemplation in the Seminary. Though it has weathered the passage of time, her sacred aura remains undimmed.

source: La pertenencia personal tardía de Señorita Flora, y también un regalo.
target: Lady Flora's late personal belonging, and also a gift.

source: La peur vient d'un manque de puissance de feu. Mais avec une arme lourde et des munitions illimitées ? Ce sont vos ennemis qui devraient avoir peur.
target: Fear is just your brain's way of saying, "Not enough firepower." But with a heavy weapon and unlimited ammo? Well, now it's your enemies' turn to sweat.

source: La phase 3 de Carnage dure 15 secondes.
target: Upon entering Rampage Lv. 3, stay in this state for 15s.

source: La photo pour Hanxiang pour réaliser son souhait.
target: Deliver the photo to Hanxiang, to fulfill her wish.

source: La pintura de Zhezhi en este abanico captura para siempre todo lo hermoso de este momento. Ella desea que recuerdes este hermoso instante cada vez que veas el abanico, sin importar dónde te encuentres.
target: Zhezhi's painting on this fan captures everything that is beautiful about this moment forever. It is her wish that you will recall this beautiful moment when you see this fan no matter where you are.

source: La pitié envers l'un peut être la cruauté envers l'autre.
target: What one calls mercy, another experiences as cruelty.

source: La pièce de monnaie circulait dans les îles Riccioli. Elle peut être utilisée pour acheter du matériel de pêche et couvrir les dépenses quotidiennes.
target: The fishery coin circulated within the Riccioli Islands. Can be used to purchase fishing gear and cover daily expenses.

source: La pièce de monnaie circulait dans les îles Riccioli. Elle peut être utilisée pour acheter du matériel de pêche et couvrir les dépenses quotidiennes.
target: The fishery coin circulated within the Riccioli Islands. Used to purchase fishing gear and cover daily expenses.

source: La placa de Calcharo de su infancia. Ha perdido su color original debido a la oxidación, todo lo que queda visible son los grabados oxidados de un perro. Las marcas parecen haber sido dibujadas de manera rudimentaria por un niño.
target: Calcharo's nameplate from his childhood. It has lost its original color due to rust, all that remains visible are the rusty carvings of a dog. The markings appear to have been crudely drawn by a child.

source: La plaque de Calcharo, datant de son enfance. Cette plaque vieille a perdu sa couleur originale à cause de la rouille. Seules les gravures rouillées d'un chien restent visibles, probablement une œuvre d'un enfant.
target: Calcharo's nameplate from his childhood. It has lost its original color due to rust, all that remains visible are the rusty carvings of a dog. The markings appear to have been crudely drawn by a child.

source: La plupart des développeurs de jeux à Solaris ignorent pourquoi les cœurs rouges représentent les PV. Mais bon, si tout le monde le fait, autant suivre le mouvement.
target: Most game developers in Solaris have no clue why a red heart represents HP. But hey, if everyone's doing it, going with the flow should be fine.

source: La plus haute distinction accordée par l'Institut à un participant à l'opération « Expédition inlandsis ». Pour Tomoe, ce sont les derniers mots que son père lui a laissés.
target: The highest honor bestowed by the Academy to the participants in the Glacier Science Research Initiative. For Zhizhi, these were the last words her father left her.

source: La poignée du Lanceur de nuage, autrefois utilisée comme moulinet de pêche par le membre de la Troupe.
target: The Cloudcaster's handle, once used as a fishing reel by the Troupe member.

source: La poignée du Lanceur de nuage, autrefois utilisée comme moulinet de pêche par le membre de la Troupe. Elle peut être assemblée avec d'autres parties du Lanceur de nuage. Collectez tous les composants et allez voir Roccia pour la prochaine étape.
target:
The Cloudcaster's handle, once used as a fishing reel by the Troupe member.
It can be assembled with other parts of the Cloudcaster. Collect all the components and go find Roccia for the next step.

source: La popularité obtenue en accomplissant les quêtes, plus la popularité est élevée, plus le marché de la lune est animé.
target: Popularity Points are gained by completing Wishes. They indicate how successful the Moonlit Fair is.

source: La première lumière de l'aube révèle le chemin à suivre.
target: Dawn's first light reveals the path ahead.

source: La resonancia nunca falla y el sabor arrasa como olas. ¡Vamos a probarlo!

source: La règle est simple : plus vous attrapez de poissons, plus vous gagnez d'expérience en tant que pêcheur, et plus vous gagnez de réputation. Mais souvenez-vous, les poissons ne sont jamais destinés à être portés comme des médailles.

source: La réalité et les souvenirs illusoires s'entremêlent pour former des fragments de rêves.

source: La réalité vous dit que la créature dont provient ce spécimen n'existe pas. Mais dans vos rêves, vous l'avez clairement vue, et elle vous a donné des conseils, vous a doté d'un grand pouvoir et vous a dit que les rêves sont aussi une réalité.
target: The reality tells you that the creature this specimen is made from does not exist. But in your dreams, you have clearly seen it and received its words of wisdom. It has given you such power to let you realize dreams are also a form of reality.

source: La résolution qui brûle pour tout ou rien

source: La sauce aigre-douce se compose d'une portion de vinaigre et de deux portions de sucre. Sauter et arroser ces ingrédients, puis on ajoute une portion d'huile chaude pour fixer les saveurs.

source: Las acciones heroicas de Chixia la han convertido en una figura célebre en Jinzhou. Aunque no buscaba la fama, los elogios sinceros que recibió la han motivado a seguir persiguiendo sus sueños.
target: Chixia's heroic actions have made her a celebrated figure in Jinzhou. Though she doesn't seek fame, the heartfelt praise she receives motivate her to continue chasing her dreams.

source: Las adivinanzas pueden parecer simples, pero llevan nuestros sentimientos al futuro, como el viento.
target: Riddles may be plain, but they carry our feelings to the future, like the wind.

source: Las almas codiciosas siempre se quejan de que el mundo no es lo suficientemente generoso.
target: The greedy souls always complain that the world is not generous enough.

source: Las brochetas favoritas de todas. Un aperitivo imprescindible en el menú de todos los restaurantes de Jinzhou, pero cada restaurante tiene su propia receta secreta. "Ven a mi lugar, mis brochetas son las auténticas!"
target: Skewers that have become a favorite for everyone in Jinzhou and must-have on the menu of every restaurant in Jinzhou. But each restaurant has its own secret recipe. "Come to my place, my skewers are the real deal!"

source: Las edades se han marcado en su superficie. El Narrador del Teatro de Jinzhou está recolectando estos fragmentos.
target: Ages had marked themselves on their surface. The Storyteller of Jinzhou Theater is collecting these fragments.

source: Las espinas de las flores silvestres habían cubierto el cristal, y las enredaderas seguían la curvatura de su mano. La chica observó largo tiempo, y finalmente extendió la mano hacia la llama bajo la vegetación.
target: The thorns of the wildflowers had encased the glass, and creeping vines traced the curve of her hand. The girl watched for a long time, and finally reached toward the flame beneath the greenery.

source: Las estrellas se ondulan al contacto con la superficie del agua. Cuando se levanta brisa, un ligero frescor recorre tus dedos.
target: Stars ripple across the water. When the wind blows, your fingertips always feel a gentle chill.

source:
Las flores floreciendo en el acantilado se mecen libremente bajo la caricia del viento habitual.
La ligera postura de las flores meciéndose con el viento es inolvidable.
target:
A blossom on cliffs, swaying to the blowing of breezes.
When the flowers swing in the currents, their light gestures always leave a strong impression.

target: Defeating overworld enemies yields 55% more Shell Credits, lasting for 30m. Only effective on your own Resonators in Co-op Mode.

source: Les esprits valeureux des combattants se transformeront en Points de chasse, alimentant les bannières.
target: The essence of bravery shown by warriors, which charges up the Banners of Conquest.

source: Les exilés peuvent y trouver des conseils et de l'expérience en matière de survie dans la nature.
target: For Exiles to read and acquire wilderness survival skills and experience.

source: Les exilés peuvent y trouver des conseils et de l'expérience en matière de survie dans la nature.
target: For Exiles to read and gain wilderness survival skills and experience

source:
Les exilés préfèrent les Viollette de terre et mangent les pousses comme un légume sauvage.
Les personnes expérimentées peuvent savoir s'il y a des exilés dans les environs en observant s'il y a ces violettes.
target:
The Exiles prefer Viola, a plant of great vitality. They cook the young shoots of Viola as a source of vegetable.
Experienced observers can determine the whereabouts of the Exiles by the distribution of Viola.

source: Les expériences vous permettent de s'adapter aux règles du monde.
target: Rich experience helps to adapt to the survival rules of this world.

source: Les flammes de l'arène attisent les acclamations, et la louve sauvage en elle déchire la gorge de chaque ombre. Elle est l'astre le plus éclatant sur le champ de bataille.
target: Flames ignite the cheers of the arena, as the wolf tears out the throats of every shadow. She is the brightest star on the field.

source:
Les fleurs qui s'épanouissent sur les falaises se balancent librement sous l'effet du vent habituel.
La légèreté des plantes fleuries qui se balancent au gré du vent est inoubliable.
target:
A blossom on cliffs, swaying to the blowing of breezes.
When the flowers swing in the currents, their light gestures always leave a strong impression.

source: Les fluides catalytiques peuvent accélérer le début de l'action de tous les types de préparations.
target: Catalytic fluids that can accelerate the onset of action of all types of potions.

source: Les fluides stabilisants améliorent la fiabilité de tous les types de formulations.
target: Stabilizing fluids that improve the reliability of all types of potions.

source: Les fluides stabilisateurs puissants peuvent améliorer considérablement la fiabilité de tous les types de formulations.
target: Strong stabilizing fluids that significantly improve the reliability of all types of potions.

source: Les fonds réservés au marché de la lune, utilisés pour la construction de bâtiments ou pour les quêtes.
target: Funds prepared for the Moonlit Fair that are used for construction or Wishes.

source: Les fruits de la salicaire à fleurs blanches, appelés pastilles, sont suspendus dans l'eau sous un feuillage dense et doivent être récoltés entiers et ramenés à la plante, où les feuilles sont soigneusement séparées des fruits pour les obtenir.
target: The fruit of Caltrop is known as tropfruit. It is produced underwater, beneath the plant's dense leaves. To obtain the fruit, the whole plant must be picked and the leaf must be carefully removed.

source: Les fréquences persistantes sur le bracelet peuvent aider à retrouver d'autres biens oubliés de cette Porteuse de Fleurs.
target: The lingering frequencies on the bracelet can help trace more of this Bloom Bearer's forgotten belongings.

source: Les huiles de cuisson fabriquées à partir de graisses animales ou de plantes oléagineuses sont des ingrédients essentiels pour la cuisine.
target: Cooking oil made from animal fat or oil-producing plants, an essential Material in cooking.

source: Les images électroniques prises à l'aide du terminal ont enregistré Shuyun dans le port.
target: A digital image recorded by the Terminal, showing Shuyun working in the Port.

source: Les images électroniques prises à l'aide du terminal ont enregistré Shuyun à la mine.
target: A digital image recorded by the Terminal, showing Shuyun working in the Mine.

source: Les informations sur le jargon fournies par M. Z.
target: Industry Lingo provided by Mr. Zi.

source: Les ingrédients riches en nutriments issus des légumineuses sont largement utilisés dans une variété de plats spécialisés pour leur goût unique.
target: A nutritious ingredient made from beans, widely used in various specialty dishes due to its unique taste.

source: Les innombrables records franchis symbolisent votre courage, qui dépasse toutes les limites.
target: The countless overwritten records epitomise your tribulations and the limit you have yet reached.

source: Les instructions d'utilisation des modules de stockage d'énergie inductive guident le personnel dans la maintenance du système électrique.
target: Notes specifically designed for the Induced Energy Storage Module, which can guide related personnel to complete the maintenance of the power system.

source: Les lettres anonymes
target: Untitled Family Letters

source: Les lions dansent sous la lune. Que la troupe fasse partie des festivités !
target: Lions dance under the moonlight. Let the Troupe be part of the festivities!

source: Les listes de vœux réalisés avec succès sont soigneusement collectées. Pour tous ceux qui travaillent dur pour le marché de la lune, c'est un souvenir précieux.
target: Completed Wish Tags are stored carefully as invaluable mementos to everyone who has worked hard to make the Moonlit Fair possible.

source: Les livres d'images de Ling Yang
target: Lingyang's picture book

source: Les marées murmurent, l'été s'attarde. Savourez cet instant de calme et de sérénité.
target: The tides murmur, summer lingers. Stay with this easy, quiet moment.

source: Les mines des tigres
target: Tiger's Maw Ore

source: Les mineurs étant occupés à leur travail, ils ajoutaient diverses épices et ingrédients pour cuisiner les plats, qui ont progressivement évolué vers le Pot-au-feu de Jinzhou d'aujourd'hui.
target: Originally a dish invented by Huanglong miners who were too busy to cook, Maocai is prepared simply by mixing and stewing all ingredients with spices in one pot.

source: Les mémoires continues ou discrètes s'assemblent pour former un réseau de conscience. « Lorsque l'on connaît suffisamment bien sa conscience, on peut maîtriser pleinement le monde des rêves.
target: When the continuous or discrete memories intertwined, a network of consciousness is formed. “When you understand your consciousness, you become the master of your dreams.”

source: Les notes philosophiques de Sizhe sur certaines idées farfelues qui viennent à l'esprit lors des missions d'enquête.
target: Notebook of Sizhe, which records his unconstrained ideas during his investigation missions.

source:
Les ondulations des vagues se transforment en germes de désir.
C'est l'écho de votre appel.
target:
The ripples of the waves converge into the sprouts of desire.
"That is the echo of your call."

source: Les parchemins métalliques avec des symboles mystérieux semblent pouvoir créer une sorte de connexion avec Nomade.
target: The metal scrolls with mysterious symbols seem to be able to create some kind of connection with Rover.

source: Les personnages de l'Équipe proches ayant activé la Compétence d'Outro de Yangyang obtient {0} points d'Énergie résonatrice par seconde pendant {1} secondes.
target: Restore {0} Resonance Energy for the Resonator on a nearby team that activates Yangyang's Outro Skill every second for {1}s.

source: Les petits vœux déjà réalisés, utilisés pour améliorer les attributs des partenaires.
target: The Wish Tag of a fulfilled wish. Used to improve characters' stats.

source: Les phases changeantes de la lune recèlent un trésor appelé vérité ....... Elles signalent peut-être tout ce qui a été et sera.
target: Within the changing Lunite lies a treasure known as truth... Perhaps it reveals everything about the past and the future.

source: Les pièces de rechange du robot militaire de Huanglong. Préparées pour faciliter le travail de réparation du conducteur en cas de défaillance du robot.
target: Spare parts for Huanglong military robots, for drivers to repair when the robot breaks down.

source: Les pièces doivent toujours rester à leur place, car quelqu'un en aura toujours besoin.
target: Parts should always be where they belong. After all, someone will always need them.

source: Les plantes qui donnent un coup de fouet épicé sont populaires dans le monde entier.
target: A plant that can give a spicy stimulus, popular all over the world.

source: Les points d'événement qui permettent d'échanger contre des récompenses.
target: Event points. Used to exchange for rewards.

source: Les points supplémentaires qui permettent d'échanger contre des récompenses à durée limitée.
target: Used to exchange limited-time extra rewards.

source: Les produits de la nature
target: Wildlife

source: Les produits laitiers naturels sont non seulement adaptés à la consommation directe, mais ils confèrent également une saveur crémeuse unique aux plats.
target: A natural dairy product, not only suitable for direct drinking, but also can provide a unique milk flavor for the dish.

source: Les produits spéciaux fabriqués à partir de combinaisons de différentes puissances peuvent apporter toute une série de bienfaits inattendus.
target: A special product that combines potions of different potencies, which may provide a variety of unexpected benefits.

source: Les provision spéciales émises par le centre commercial. Ces colis sont livrés par Loulou Logistique.
target: The special supply pack issued by the Store. It is delivered to the customer by Lollo Logistics.

source: Les précieux dossiers expérimentaux ramenés de la Tour éprouvante peuvent être échangés contre diverses récompenses dans la boutique de la Tour.
target: The precious experimental records brought back from the Tower of Adversity can be exchanged for various rewards in the Adversity Exchange.

source: Les rares vestiges de la civilisation le traversent... Il offre peut-être des possibilités infinies.
target: The precious remnants of the civilization reverberate within... Perhaps they hold infinite possibilities.

source: Les résonateurs qui ont des certificats d'autorisation peuvent placer des senseurs des trésors pour trouver les coffres de provision et les héritages de la maréede près. Ce module facilite l'exploration et l'aventure.
target: The Lootmapper identifies specific frequencies to quickly locate nearby undiscovered Supply Chests and Tidal Heritage. It is an indispensable tool to facilitate exploration in the wilds.

source: Les rêves qui fleurissent
target: Blossoms in Dreams

source: Les souvenirs liés avec une personne. Sa force et sa fragilité, ses souffrances et ses joies, tout ce qu'elle était, ne demeurent que dans ce fragment doré meurtri mais radieux.
target: Memories of that person—their strength and frailty, their suffering and joy, everything that was them—remain only in this battered yet radiant golden fragment.

source: Les souvenirs peuvent s'estomper, mais cette amitié inter-royaumes conservera ses couleurs.
target: Memory may fade, but this cross-realm friendship will keep its colors.

source: Les stigmates de la vanité
target: The Stigma that Signifies Vainglory

source: Les tests et les accessoires laissés par les soldats sont vus dans les répliques.
target: props left behind by soldiers seen in replicas

source: Les trois étapes du chant du rêve - Les larmes des feuilles de pierre
target: "Dream Return Song III: Stone Leaf Tears"

source: Les vagues qui purifie le monde
target: The Wave that Cleanses the World

source: Les vestiges de l'érosion marine montrent une structure imbriquée de doubles coquilles sphériques, mais l'état d'équilibre qu'elles maintenaient a été perturbé et les échos hébergés par le noyau interne se sont décomposés en sons résiduels.
target: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. However, the inner balance has been disturbed, causing the Remnant within the inner core to reduce to the Reverberation.

source: Les vestiges marins, qui présentent une structure imbriquée à double couche de coquilles sphériques, ne sont pas encore en phase de récession. Il pourrait être possible d'en extraire de l'énergie vestigiale si l'on choisit le bon absorbeur.
target: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is not in a state of decline. By selecting an appropriate absorber, users may still have the chance to extract Remnant Energy.

source: Les visiteurs admirent votre moto, comme s'ils apercevaient la longue route que vous avez parcourue.
target: Visitors admire your motorbike as though they could see the long, winding road you traveled.

source:
Les voix du passé sont maintenant superposées par de nouveaux souvenirs.
Au fur et à mesure que la bande tourne, passé et futur s'entrelacent en un seul rouleau.
target: Voices from the past are now overlaid by new memories. As the tape turns, past and future wind into a single reel.

source: Les yeux de ce mystérieux poisson géant scintillent d'une lueur étrange, et si vous écoutez attentivement, vous pourriez même capter une mélodie faible dans les éclats de lumière. Il ne fait aucun doute que c'est l'un des dons des mers.
target: The eyes of this mysterious giant fish gleam with an eerie glow, and if you listen closely, you might even catch a faint melody within the flickers. Undoubtedly, it is one of the ocean's gifts.

source: Les Îles Riccioli, un territoire de Rinascita, utilisent également des Crédits coquilles. Cependant, les pêcheurs et marins y ont leur propre monnaie unique pour le commerce maritime.
target: The Riccioli Islands, a territory of Rinascita, uses Shell Credits as well. However, fishermen and sailors there have their own unique currency for sea trade.

source: Les écrans installés par Loulou Logistique et l'Académie Brandétoile vous rappellent parfois des choses qui vont au-delà de la fête.
target: The screen set up by Lollo Logistics and Startorch Academy occasionally remind you of matters beyond the party.

source: Les épines des fleurs sauvages avaient encerclé le verre, et des lianes rampantes traçaient la courbe de sa main. La jeune fille observa longtemps, et finalement tendit la main vers la flamme sous la verdure.
target: The thorns of the wildflowers had encased the glass, and creeping vines traced the curve of her hand. The girl watched for a long time, and finally reached toward the flame beneath the greenery.

source: Les étoiles scintillent à la surface de l'eau tandis qu'au moindre souffle de vent, une fraîcheur subtile vient caresser le bout de vos doigts.
target: Stars ripple across the water. When the wind blows, your fingertips always feel a gentle chill.

source: Los Ataúdes de Sonancia en Raguna suelen estar en lugares difíciles de alcanzar. Usa el Ancla para acceder con facilidad. Una vez entregados a los peluches del Parque Perdido, pueden intercambiarse por recursos.

source: Na beira da noite, alguém uma vez acendeu um fogo de artifício. Desde então, tudo que é brilhante subiu aos céus, enquanto tudo que é sombrio afundou para sempre nas profundezas dos sonhos.
target: At the edge of night, someone once lit a firework. Since then, all that is bright has soared to the heavens, while all that is dim has sunk forever into the depths of dreams.

source: Na escuridão abissal, você acalmou inúmeras tempestades sem nome. Sob o farol que você acendeu, almas errantes finalmente encontraram o caminho para casa.
target: In the abyssal dark, you stilled numerous tempests unnamed. Under the beacon you ignited, wandering souls have finally found their way home.

source: Na fissura, uma Marca Transgressora está se expandindo, pulsando com um ritmo surdo como uma batida do coração...
target: In the fissure, a Tacet Mark is expanding, pulsing with a thudding rhythm like a heartbeat...

source: Na névoa morna da fonte termal interna, atrás dos véus de chiffon tremulantes, a ninfa coroada de louro lança seu olhar gentil, um sinal de convite para umas férias despreocupadas há muito esperadas.
target: In the warm mist of the indoor hot spring, behind the fluttering chiffon veils, the laurel-crowned nymph casts her gentle gaze—a signal of invitation to a long-awaited, carefree holiday.

source: Nach 3 Treffern durch Standardangriff verursacht der nächste Schwere Angriff Glacio-SCH und fügt Glacio-Reibung zu.

source: Nach Abschluss der Gezeitenfäule-Simulationen erhältst du Bewertungssterne, die zum Freischalten der Wächterprotokolle verwendet werden.

target: The Burning Waves state becomes permanent. While in Burning Waves, Resonators deal 50% more DMG.

source: O festival está aqui, esperando que todos aproveitem as guloseimas deste ano.
target: Festival's here, hoping everyone enjoys this year's treats.

source: O final que ela havia previsto nunca aconteceu. O que se desenrolou foi mais um ciclo.
target: The ending she had predicted never came to pass. What unfolded was yet another cycle.

source: O fogo queima minha carne, mas meu espírito se renova.
target: Fire scorches my flesh, yet my spirit emerges renewed.

source: O fruto da Castanha-d'água é conhecido como tropifruta. Ele é produzido debaixo de água, sob as folhas densas da planta. Para obter o fruto, deve-se colher toda a planta e retirar a folha com cuidado.
target: The fruit of Caltrop is known as tropfruit. It is produced underwater, beneath the plant's dense leaves. To obtain the fruit, the whole plant must be picked and the leaf must be carefully removed.

source: O fruto da Árvore Anciã Ruína do Vazio. Sua casca, estruturada como uma grade óptica, projeta arco-íris dançantes em sua superfície quando atingida pela luz. Um tesouro para aqueles que estudam óptica, botânica e biônica.
target: The fruit of the Voidbane Eldertree. Its skin, structured like an optical grating, casts dancing rainbows across its surface when struck by light. A treasure for those who study optics, botany, and bionics alike.

source:
O guarda-chuva das lendas urbanas, que supostamente está ligado a várias desventuras.
Um boato depois desmentido por Namipon.
target:
The umbrella from urban legends, said to be somehow linked to several misadventures.
A rumor later debunked by Namipon.

source: O guqin de sete cordas presenteado por Qingxiao, seu presente de iniciação exclusivo.
target: A gracefully crafted seven-string guqin, given to you by Qingxiao as an initiation gift.

source: O inimigo, aproximando-se de sua forma completa, vê isso como a arma mais potente, que semeia implacavelmente sementes de destruição e desperta o medo primordial da humanidade pela guerra.
target: The foe, nearing its complete form, views this as the most potent weapon, which relentlessly sows seeds of destruction and awakens humanity's primal fear of war.

source: O lendário primeiro cartucho de jogo para o primeiro console de videogame da história. Reverenciado pelos entusiastas como uma relíquia sagrada.
target: The legendary first-ever game cartridge for the first-ever video game console. Revered by enthusiasts as a sacred relic.

source: O limite de acúmulo de Status - Perdição de Erosionda é aumentado.
target: Stack cap of Status - Waveworn Bane is increased.

source: O mal afundou seu navio, tentando sufocar sua alegria. Em vez disso, eles transformaram seus últimos momentos em uma celebração ardente, cantando e dançando sobre o mar em chamas.
target: Evil sank their ship, trying to stifle their joy. Instead, they turned their last moments into a fiery celebration, singing and dancing atop the blazing sea.

source: O manual de esgrima tem uma suave Energia de Espada ao seu redor. Apesar do passar de muitos anos, apenas um leve desgaste é visto em suas bordas. O proprietário deve tê-lo valorizado muito.
target: A swordcraft manual with gentle Sword Energy soaked into it. Despite the passage of many years, only slight wear is evident along its edges. Its keeper must have treasured it greatly.

source: O manuscrito original armazenado no dispositivo de informação.
target: The original manuscript stored in the information device.

source: O material sonoro feito de áudio suspeito que apareceu na Pradaria Calcinante.
target: The sound material made from suspicious audio which appeared in the Blazing Prairie.

source: O material sonoro que pode reproduzir a cena após o uso.
target: The sound material that can reproduce the scene after use.

source: O medo é apenas a forma do seu cérebro dizer: "Poder de fogo insuficiente". Mas com uma arma pesada e munição ilimitada? Bem, agora é a vez dos seus inimigos suarem.
target: Fear is just your brain's way of saying, "Not enough firepower." But with a heavy weapon and unlimited ammo? Well, now it's your enemies' turn to sweat.

source: O melhor filme é o próximo filme.
target: The best movie is the next movie.

source: O minério amarelo obtido após remover a casca de Tacetita é moldado como tacetrita, mas na verdade ainda é Tacetita, e geralmente é usado pelos Líderes Exilados.
target: The yellow ore obtained after removing the Tacetite shell is shaped like Tacetreite, but is actually still Tacetite, and is usually used by the Exile Leaders.

source: O misterioso ornamento especial preparado por Namipon.
target: The mysterious special ornament prepared by Namipon.

source: O modelo de reprodutor musical portátil usado pelo protagonista de uma obra conhecida.
target: The portable music player model used by the protagonist of a well-known work.

source: O motor do robô militar de Huanglong, que parece comum, mas é a parte mais importante do robô.
target: The engine of the Huanglong military robot, which looks ordinary, but is the most important part of the robot.

source: O módulo central do Poste Móvel, responsável por coletar, compartilhar e atualizar informações de localização. Ele conecta o Poste Móvel e o Poste de Ressonância, tornando-o essencial para iniciar e manter o funcionamento do Poste Móvel.
target: The core module of the Waypoint, responsible for collecting, sharing, and updating location information. It connects the Waypoint and the Resonance Beacon, making it essential for initiating and maintaining the functioning of the Waypoint.

source: O ninho do Tecelão de Folhas, um tipo de inseto que canta. Meticulosamente estruturado, é construído principalmente com folhas e pétalas.
target: The nest of Leafweaver, a kind of chirping insect. Meticulously structured, it is primarily built from leaves and petals.

source: O núcleo do Destronado. Apenas mais conflito e sacrifício podem reparar as rachaduras e vazios dentro deste Núcleo Transgressor.
target: The core of Crownless's clone. Only more strife and sacrifice can mend the cracks and voids within this Tacet Core.

source: O núcleo do Mefítico Tempestuoso. Como uma nuvem de tempestade em miniatura, o trovão estrondoso se espalha do Núcleo Transgressor, fazendo com que os arredores tremam em seu rastro.
target: The core of Tempest Mephis. Like a miniature thundercloud, the rumbling thunder spreads from the Tacet Core, causing the surroundings to quiver in its wake.

source: O núcleo do Mefítico Tonitruante. Como uma tempestade em miniatura, o núcleo irradia uma luz deslumbrante entre os clarões.
target: The core of Thundering Mephis. Like a miniature thunderstorm, the core radiates a dazzling light between the flashes.

source: O ovo da Águia de Penas de Jade, um predador de topo na Terra de Xuanfang. É enorme, de cor verde-ciano e brilhante como jade puro.
target: The egg of the Jadeplume Eagle, an apex predator in the Land of Xuanfang. It is massive, cyan-green in color, and lustrous like pure jade.

source: O pacote de suprimentos especial emitido pela Loja. É entregue ao cliente pela Logística Lollo. Abra para resgatar suprimentos valiosos.
target: The special supply pack issued by the Store. It is delivered to the customer by Lollo Logistics. Open to claim rich supplies.

source: O paraíso de Encore é na terra da imaginação. Guerreiros Lanosos corajosos e seus companheiros lanosos saltam das páginas dos livros para um "Felizes para Sempre".
target: Encore's paradise is in the land of imagination. Brave Wooly Warriors and their wooly companions leap from the pages of books to a "Happily Ever After."

source: O passado não pode ser mudado; o futuro ainda está por vir.
target: The past cannot be changed; the future has yet to come.

source: O pingente de jade é claro e puro, refletindo o coração de seu dono.
target: The jade pendant is clear and pure, reflecting the heart of its owner.

source: O primeiro gosto desperta de alguma forma uma sensação de nostalgia.
target: The first taste of it somehow stirs a sense of nostalgia.

source: O produto de uma Esfera Sonora colapsada, espalhada por todo o mundo. Registra as memórias não distorcidas do passado. Os Pelúcias estão coletando-as — talvez tenham algo em troca.
target: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past. The Plushies are collecting them—perhaps they'll have something in exchange.

source: O produto de uma esfera sonora colapsada, espalhada por todo o mundo. Ela registra as lembranças não distorcidas do passado.
target: The product of a collapsed Sonoro Sphere, scattered all over the world. It records the untwisted memories of the past.

source: O que Aguarda Além do Resplendor
target: What Awaits Beyond the Radiance

source: O que pode ser observado pode ser sentido, e o que pode ser sentido pode ser compreendido.
target: What can be observed can be sensed, and what can be sensed can be understood.

source: O que um chama de misericórdia, outros conhecem como crueldade.
target: What one calls mercy, another experiences as cruelty.

source: O que vem a seguir é uma longa jornada — uma busca implacável até os confins do mundo.
target: What follows is a long voyage—a relentless pursuit to the every edge of the world.

source: O que é o Sol? Ela é aquela que oferece calor e radiância sem fim. A esta terra ancestral, ela dedica seu sangue, sua glória e sua vida. E assim, ela se torna o Sol, o resplendor eterno para todos contemplarem.
target: What is the Sun? She is the one who offers warmth and radiance without end. To this ancient land, she devotes her blood, her glory, and her life. And thus, she becomes the Sun, the eternal blaze for all to look upon.

source: O sabor original da Água Gasosa Namipon que pode ser encontrada em todos os lugares de Honami. Amada tanto por idosos quanto por crianças.
target: The original flavor of Namipon's Sparkling Water that can be found everywhere in Honami. Loved by both elders and children.

source:
O sanduíche matinal perfeito — delicioso, rápido e saudável.
Mesmo o pão mais simples possui potencial infinito. Como a vida, um panini pode parecer o mesmo todos os dias, mas é sempre um pouco diferente.
target:
The perfect morning sandwich—delicious, quick, and wholesome.
Even the simplest bread holds infinite potential. Like life, a panini may seem the same every day, but it is always a little different.

source: O sino que Lingyang usou durante a apresentação. Como agradecimento pela sua companhia, Lingyang deu-o a você.
target: A bell worn by Lingyang during performances. As a token of gratitude for accompanying her on her journey, Lingyang gave it to you.

source: O sino que Lingyang usou durante a apresentação. Como agradecimento pela sua companhia, Lingyang deu-o a você.
target: The bell that Lingyang wore during the performance. As a thank you for the journey, Lingyang gave it to you.

source: O soco-inglês que Zani costumava usar, tão famoso quanto a própria lenda do Anda-noite Flamejante.
target: The brass knuckles Zani used to wear, as famous as the Blazing Nightwalker's tale itself.

source: O som da fonte parece rimar com o riso das pessoas.
target: The sound of the fountain seems to rhyme with the laughter of the people.

source: O som da maré encontra a luz cambiante, como um chamado distante ecoando lentamente entre o mar e as estrelas.
target: The sound of the tide meets the shifting light, like a distant call echoing slowly between sea and stars.

source: O talismã daquela criança.
target: The talisman of that child.

source: O tempo está inquestionavelmente do nosso lado, embora a pegadinha seja levantar cedo nessas manhãs frias.
target: Time is undoubtedly on our side, though the catch is getting up early on those chilly mornings.

source: O tempo que passamos no palco faz nossos desejos brilharem mais intensamente.
target: The time we spend on stage makes our wishes shine brighter.

source: O tempo talvez nunca retorne, mas a música sempre carrega o poder de ressoar através das eras.
target: Time may never turn back, but music always carries the power to resonate across eras.

source: O tio Wei diz que o molho para brasear é feito cozinhando carne de ave. Portanto, 1 porção de carne de ave será indispensável.
target: Uncle Wei says, Braising Sauce is made by stewing Fowl Meat. Therefore, 1 serving of Fowl Meat is indispensable.

source: O trovão está ressoando na fenda...
target: Thunder is rumbling in the crevice...

source: O verdadeiro domínio do Leihuangquan é difícil de se alcançar.
target: True mastery of Leihuangquan is hard to achieve.

source: O vinagre é um condimento líquido azedo fermentado, encontrado em todas as cozinhas desde que a civilização humana existe.
target: Vinegar is a fermented sour liquid condiment, found in every kitchen for as long as the human civilization exists.

source: O voucher usado para participar da loteria especial do Gênio Lollo.
target: The voucher used to participate in the Lollo Genie special lottery.

source: O último item comemorativo obtido com a restauração da Aldeia Pelúcia.
target: The last commemorative item earned from restoring the Plushie Village.

source:
Ob du die Agons zuhause schaust oder jeden Kampf in der Arena verfolgst – er ist immer für dich da!
Null Zucker und null Kalorien, aus Blutblatt-Schneeball. Lass ihn die Arena zum Sprudeln bringen!
target:
Whether you're watching Agons or catching every clash in the arena, it's there for you.
Zero sugar. Zero calories. Packed with Bloodleaf Viburnums. Let it fire up the arena!

target: An item that can remove the Lifer's buff.
